items.title: Call to Order
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman called the meeting to order at 4:14 p.m. She noted that the purpose of this meeting is to consider a by-law to amend the Controlled Access By-law #58-87.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

items.title: PDL-CAS-25-010, 2026 Council and Committee Meeting Calendar
notes: The report and recommendation were deferred to the Council meeting to be held on August 27, 2025.

attachments.name: PDL-CAS-25-010, 2026 Council and Committee Meeting Calendar.pdf

items.title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
notes: The proposed Confirming By-law 25-035 was removed from consideration as item 4.1 was deferred.

motions.item_title: PDL-CAS-25-010, 2026 Council and Committee Meeting Calendar
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo adopt the 2026 Council and Committee Meeting Calendar attached to Report PDL-CAS-25-010 as Appendix “A” dated June 25, 2025.
motions.text_html: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo adopt the 2026 Council and Committee Meeting Calendar attached to Report PDL-CAS-25-010 as Appendix “A” dated June 25, 2025.

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.

That a By-law to Amend By-law Number 58-87, as Amended, being a By-law to Designate and Regulate Controlled-Access Roads (for Access to Regional Road #17 (Fountain Street North), Township of Woolwich), be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-034, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to Amend By-law Number 58-87, as Amended, being a By-law to Designate and Regulate Controlled-Access Roads (for Access to Regional Road #17 (Fountain Street North), Township of Woolwich), be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-034, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 4:18 p.m.
